title: A Giant Swamp Slug
description: A Giant Swamp Slug rises on Dagobah to challenge other creatures for supremacy of the bog (front). Part of a cache of new McQuarrie art, the painting will appear next year in a new Bantam book, THE ILLUSTRATED STAR WARS UNIVERSE, which will explore previously unseen corners of the STAR WARS universe. In pre-production art from 1979 (back), McQuarrie envisions another Dagobah denizen, a giant spider about to attack Luke Skywalker.
